title: Allow the wallpaper colour to adhere to the current theme
line: The Plain Color wallpaper can now follow the color scheme, so it turns dark or light together with the rest of Plasma.
explanation: The Plain Color wallpaper only stored one fixed color, so anyone switching between light and dark color schemes (by hand or with the automatic day/night switching) had to pick a matching color again each time. The change adds a "From current color scheme" choice next to a "Custom:" color button in the wallpaper settings; when chosen, the wallpaper (and the accent color it reports) uses the color scheme's window background color and updates live when the scheme changes.

commits.message:
wallpapers/color: add an option to follow the color scheme

The Plain Color wallpaper could only show one fixed color, so people who
switch between light and dark color schemes had to pick a new color by
hand each time. Add a "From current color scheme" choice that uses it.

BUG: 487213

patches.diff:
From 720016d45c977dae259da3855556cd31d4b9f817 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:11:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/color: add an option to follow the color scheme

The Plain Color wallpaper could only show one fixed color, so people who
switch between light and dark color schemes had to pick a new color by
hand each time. Add a "From current color scheme" choice that uses it.

BUG: 487213
---
 wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml |  4 ++++
 wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml   | 29 ++++++++++++++++++++---
 wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml     |  9 +++++--
 3 files changed, 37 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
index 927dc73789..a07ef0dbd5 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -10,6 +10,10 @@
       <label>Color of the wallpaper</label>
       <default>#1d99f3</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="FollowColorScheme" type="Bool">
+      <label>Use the background color of the current color scheme</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
index 774a9daded..46018c23ab 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -6,6 +6,8 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
+import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.kquickcontrols as KQuickControls
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
@@ -14,11 +16,32 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     twinFormLayouts: parentLayout
 
     property alias cfg_Color: colorButton.color
+    property alias cfg_FollowColorScheme: colorSchemeRadioButton.checked
     property alias formLayout: root
 
-    KQuickControls.ColorButton {
-        id: colorButton
+    QQC2.ButtonGroup {
+        id: colorGroup
+    }
+
+    QQC2.RadioButton {
+        id: colorSchemeRadioButton
         Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Color:")
-        dialogTitle: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Select Background Color")
+        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "From current color scheme")
+        QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: colorGroup
+    }
+
+    RowLayout {
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            id: customColorRadioButton
+            text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Custom:")
+            checked: !colorSchemeRadioButton.checked
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: colorGroup
+        }
+
+        KQuickControls.ColorButton {
+            id: colorButton
+            enabled: customColorRadioButton.checked
+            dialogTitle: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.color", "Select Background Color")
+        }
     }
 }
diff --git a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
index 38e0517f34..c558e596a3 100644
--- a/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/color/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -11,11 +11,16 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 WallpaperItem {
     id: root
 
-    accentColor: root.configuration.Color
+    readonly property color color: root.configuration.FollowColorScheme ? Kirigami.Theme.backgroundColor : root.configuration.Color
+
+    accentColor: root.color
+
+    Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
+    Kirigami.Theme.inherit: false
 
     Rectangle {
         anchors.fill: parent
-        color: root.configuration.Color
+        color: root.color
 
         Behavior on color {
             ColorAnimation {
--
